description: This source file defines the `TransactionalStateStorageProviderWrapper<TState>` class, which implements transaction-aware state storage logic for Orleans grains. It provides methods to load and store transactional state, handling concurrency, versioning via ETags, and managing pending transaction states. Additionally, it contains the `TransactionalStateRecord<TState>` class used as the record structure for the stored transactional state.

classes.name: TransactionalStateStorageProviderWrapper<TState>
classes.description: A wrapper for transactional state storage in Orleans, supporting load, store, and concurrency control mechanisms for transactional grain state.

classes.name: TransactionalStateRecord<TState>
classes.description: Represents a stored record of transactional state, including committed state, sequence ID, metadata, and pending states.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the transactional state asynchronously, returning the current committed state and metadata.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores transactional state atomically, with support for concurrency control via ETag, and manages pending transactions, commits, and aborts.

methods.name: GetStateStorage
methods.description: Initializes and returns the storage bridge for the transactional state.
